svg.title: alphaScreen sales SMS verbal consent script
svg.desc: The exact prompt alphaScreen sales representatives read during a recorded call before sending text messages.

text.tspan: “Before I text you, do you agree to receive text messages from
alphaSource Network LLC about alphaScreen, including the
information you requested, demo scheduling and reminders, and
occasional promotional follow-ups? Message frequency varies.
Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of
purchase. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help.
Do I have your permission to text this number?”
Proceed only after an unambiguous yes and confirmation of the mobile number.
Index the consent date, time, representative, number, verbal source, and call recording.
The recorded call is the supporting consent evidence. No clear yes means no text.
